title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: early closure fee and interest on closure by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference gives, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the early closure fee, the length of the early closure window, and whether interest accrued since the last statement cycle close is paid when the account closes part way through a cycle.

## Definitions

- **Early closure fee**: the fee charged when the owner closes the account within the early closure window, in USD.
- **Early closure window**: the number of calendar days after the opening date during which a customer closure incurs the early closure fee.
- **Accrued interest paid on closure**: whether interest accrued since the last cycle close is paid when the account closes mid-cycle; "forfeited" means it is not paid.

## Tier table

| Tier | Early closure fee | Early closure window | Accrued interest on closure |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | USD 0.00 | 90 calendar days | forfeited |
| Statement Savings | USD 25.00 | 90 calendar days | forfeited |
| Goal Builder Savings | USD 25.00 | 90 calendar days | forfeited |
| Money Market Account | USD 25.00 | 90 calendar days | paid |
| Premier Money Market | USD 25.00 | 90 calendar days | paid |
| Private Client Money Market | USD 25.00 | 90 calendar days | paid |

## Reading the table

- The window is 90 calendar days on every tier. Starter Savings has a window but its fee is USD 0.00, so a closure within the window costs nothing on that tier.
- The three savings tiers (Starter, Statement, Goal Builder) forfeit interest accrued since the last cycle close when they close mid-cycle; the three money market tiers pay it.

## Points of judgement

**A Money Market Account closes part way through a statement cycle. Is the interest accrued since the last cycle close lost?** No; the Money Market Account pays it.

**A Goal Builder Savings account closes part way through a statement cycle. Is the interest accrued since the last cycle close paid?** No; Goal Builder Savings forfeits it.
